criteria.statement: When the Chromium install step in the "Jest (hooks)" job fails or times out, the "Run Jest" step still runs: no install outcome causes "Run Jest" to be skipped
criteria.reason: Fresh parse of the current ci.yml: the cache (step 4), download (5) and fonts (6) steps all carry continue-on-error=true, and Run Jest (7) has no if: condition, so a failed or timed-out install cannot skip it. Confirmed against ci.yml lines 78-100; actionlint exit=0 in it2-actionlint.txt.

criteria.statement: The Chromium install is bounded in time by a step-level limit that leaves room, inside the job-level timeout, for `npm ci` and "Run Jest" to complete
criteria.cites: §Reproduction Root cause (no step-level timeout-minutes; last green timings npm ci 3s, Jest 87s)
criteria.reason: Step bounds cache 1 min + download 3 min + fonts 2 min = 360 s; plus npm ci 3 s and Jest 87 s = 450 s, under the 600 s job limit (150 s headroom). Values match it2-parse.txt and ci.yml. (it2-parse.txt's trailing ARITH line still prints the older 390 s sum that omits the cache step; it2-arith.txt carries the corrected sum.)

criteria.statement: Downloading the Chromium browser itself does not depend on apt: an unreachable apt mirror cannot stop or delay the browser download
criteria.reason: The download step runs `timeout -k 5 80 npx playwright install chromium` (twice, then a warning) with no --with-deps; the parse prints 'steps before Run Jest with --with-deps: 0'. apt work is only in the separate step 6 (`playwright install-deps chromium`), bounded at 2 min and soft-failing.

criteria.statement: With Chromium unavailable, every Jest suite that does not drive a browser runs and reports its result
criteria.reason: All 96 suites ran and reported with Chromium unavailable (8 failed, 88 passed). The 5 non-browser failures are Chromium-independent: 4 fail identically with the browser present, custody.test.js is the known flake.

criteria.statement: With Chromium unavailable, at most three suites fail, and every suite that fails is one that drives the browser
criteria.reason: Literal count not observable here: 8 suites fail locally, 5 for local reasons regardless of Chromium (Node version vs mock-fs, sandboxed /tmp chmod, custody flake). The differential shows only the three browser suites (design-bundle, design-render, design-render-walk) depend on Chromium. A clean count needs the CI runner, which verification.md section 5 says cannot be reproduced here.
criteria.blocker: Clean per-suite failure count needs the GitHub Actions runner (Node 20, ubuntu-24.04); local machine has Chromium-independent failures (verification.md section 5).

criteria.statement: With Chromium unavailable, the "Jest (hooks)" job ends failed, never green: the browser suites' loss is reported, not hidden by the install's fallback
criteria.reason: The browser-absent Jest run ends 'Tests: 33 failed' and JEST_EXIT=1; the fresh parse shows Run Jest carries no continue-on-error and the job has none either (ci.yml lines 35-41), so the job ends failed, not green.

criteria.statement: When a browser suite fails because Chromium is missing, its failure message names the missing browser, so an outage-day red run is distinguishable from a render regression
criteria.reason: Every failing test in the three browser suites reports 'Playwright's Chromium is not installed: run `npx playwright install chromium`' from design-render.js launch().
